hypotheses.subject: legacy-checkout-fallback
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag legacy-checkout-fallback was switched off at 13:35, and the non-fallback code path on the account page divides by zero. Error rate jumped from ~1% to 14% in the first partially-rolled minute (off 105 / on 95) and to ~31-33% once evaluations were fully 'off'.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
INFO io-shop: legacy-checkout-fallback=on - 200 evaluations (with only sporadic UpstreamTimeout errors and 0-2% error rate) through 13:34
flag-toggle: feature flag legacy-checkout-fallback was switched off (actor: admin)
error_rate 0.0 at 13:34 rising to 0.145 at 13:35 and 0.335 at 13:36, request_volume flat at 1200

hypotheses.summary: Alternative reading: a code change shipped without a recorded deploy entry introduced the ZeroDivisionError, and the flag flip merely exposed it. No deployment appears in the change log for the whole 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-12 window, so this is unsupported by evidence.

supporting_evidence.claim: Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-10T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-12T13:40:28Z contains only one entry, a flag-toggle - no deploy is recorded
